description:
The dispatch table that selects logical kernels exposes fifteen public function-pointer fields with no per-field documentation, so a caller cannot tell what any one of them expects without reading the kernel it points at.

## Background

The struct sits at `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/lib.rs:83`. Its type-level comment states only that the kernels have identical semantics to the scalar implementation, which says nothing about what each individual entry takes.

What a caller needs per field is the shape of the slices involved, whether the operation writes in place or to a separate destination, any length or alignment precondition, and what the operation computes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the fifteen fields carries documentation stating what the kernel computes, the shape of its slice arguments, and any length or alignment precondition.
- [hard] REQ-02: Documentation states whether each kernel writes in place or to a separate destination.
- [hard] REQ-03: The field documentation is accurate against the kernels currently assigned to each entry, verified by reading them rather than inferred from field names.
- [hard] REQ-04: Documentation builds without warnings, and clippy with warnings denied plus formatting pass.
title: Document the individual LogicalFns dispatch fields
